description.p: iptvXS is a modern IPTV viewer built with Qt6 and libmpv. It supports Xtream Codes and M3U playlist formats with features including an electronic programme guide (EPG), scheduled and live recording, Google Drive upload, favorites, and a theming system.

ul.li: Xtream Codes API and M3U playlist support
High-quality playback via libmpv with OpenGL rendering
Electronic Programme Guide (EPG) with XMLTV parser
Scheduled and live recording with ffmpeg
Multiple themes (Midnight, Ocean, Forest, Sunset, Nord, Light)

description.p: Initial release with full IPTV viewer functionality.
